{{Top}}
[[File:WrathBDZ-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought ''Wrath'' leading a Base Delta Zero operation, during the initial stages.]]
{{Quote|Base Delta Zero is the Imperial code order to destroy all population centers and resources, including industry, natural resources, and cities.|[[Michael Unther]]|<ref name="AWTC">{{JournalCite|2|A World to Conquer}}</ref>}}
'''Base Delta Zero''' was the naval code used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to order the complete surface destruction of a planetary target, eliminating all life, industry, and natural resources on the surface. Similar actions were known to have been carried out by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The Moff... wants Nar Shaddaa reduced to rubble.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Winstel Greelanx]]|<ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>}}
Defined as "the systematic complete destruction of all 'assets' of production, including factories, arable land, mines, fisheries, and all sentient beings and [[Droid/Legends|droids]],"<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> Base Delta Zero denoted the most severe of several levels of destruction that could be directed against a center of resistance, and involved laying waste to an entire planet by [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], reducing the upper crust of a planet to molten slag<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref><ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> or in some cases, atomizing the planet's top-soil.<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>

A Base Delta Zero fleet bombardment was regarded as one of the most devastating operations that the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] was capable of, and unlike other Imperial military codes, the designation was not subject to change, so that there was never any confusion when it was issued. Due to its effects, BDZs were considered a last resort.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="AWTC" />

==History==
{{Quote|They're going to raze the planet...|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during the [[Battle of Terra Sool]]|<ref name="Skywalkers">{{CWACite|2|Skywalkers}}</ref>}}
[[File:BaseDeltaZero.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A ''Victory''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] performing a Base Delta Zero operation]]
Devastating planetary bombardments were recorded from the earliest millennia of galactic history. For instance, the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] laid waste to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] before the dawn of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]],<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> and around 4000 BBY, [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|devastated]] by firestorms created by [[The Force/Legends|Force]] energy,<ref name="TOTJTSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> while the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces in the [[Jedi Civil War]] obliterated the surfaces of [[Telos IV]] in 3958 BBY and [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in 3956 BBY.<ref name="KOTOR" /> But these atrocities paled before the power of a Base Delta Zero operation. Even hardened Imperial officers who were well versed in invasion operations found the tactic unsettling. Some saw it worse than destroying the planet outright.

It is not known when the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] introduced the Base Delta Zero code, but during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the order gained new notoriety when Republic fleets were used to destroy [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] armies entrenched deep underground.<ref name="AOTC:ICS" />

Under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Base Delta Zero operations continued to be mounted primarily against targets that the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] had failed to gain control of by direct assault, but such missions acquired increasingly punitive overtones, being used against rebellious planets where the Empire judged a ground assault would incur too many Imperial casualties, or simply where forces were not available to mount a direct attack. As few as three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] could execute such operations in a "matter of hours."

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Imperial warships used the BDZ tactic on the planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]].<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> However, Imperial involvement was suspected only and could not be proven until the [[Caamas Document]] was discovered in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="SOTP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sarn Shild]] gave a Base Delta Zero command targeting the smugglers' haven of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. This order was not carried out because of the Imperial defeat at the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="THG" />
Another notorious Imperial-era atrocity, the bombardment of [[Emberlene]], was often blamed on the Empire by the locals despite having nothing to do with it.<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> At one point, the [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Wrath (Assertor-class)/Legends|''Wrath'']] led a Base Delta Zero operation, which involved various [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]] squadrons, some [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], and at least one [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In addition to naval bombardment, army missions with the same objective as a Base Delta Zero command were undertaken to combat the enemies of the Empire. The mercenary unit [[First Sun Mobile Regiment]] was often hired by the Galactic Empire to destroy all enemy assets similarly to a BDZ bombardment.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>

The Empire continued to use devastating bombardment tactics, for instance at [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]], and some of these may have been Base Delta Zeroes;<ref name="DF:RA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> but the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] rejected planetary bombardment missions outright, until [[Operation Emperor's Hammer]] during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].<ref name="ELI:RD">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>
